opening.argument: The video presents a Chipotle buy-one-get-one food offer: a burrito, bowl, salad, or tacos is free when the corresponding item is purchased. The claim process is described as obtaining a coupon, with viewers directed to a description link to choose ingredients, then asked for a name and cell phone number so the coupon can be sent by text. The stated expiration date and one-per-person, one-per-cell-phone-number limit further frame it as an ordinary purchase-based promotion. The video does not establish the external destination's affiliation or how the requested information will be used, but it does not present an investment, payment, or credential request.

citations.quote: They are offering a free burrito when you buy one, a free burrito bowl when you buy one, a free salad when you buy one, or a free order of tacos when you buy one.
All you have to do to get the coupon is click on the link in my description and make your mix of the ingredients you like on your food.
After that, they'll ask you for your name and your cell phone number and then they will text you the coupon!
Now the coupon is good through August 31st but there's a limit of one per person per cell phone number.
